Name: Trash Does Not Consume Bait
Author: atravita
Description:
This mod prevents trash from consuming bait. Additionally, it adds automatic replacement of tackles/bait when they run out. When replacing, the code will try to use the same bait/tackle you were using, but if you don't have that particular tackle/bait remaining in your inventory, it can optionally use whatever you have on hand. It will only use bait/tackle in your inventory.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]AutomaticRefill[/font]: Toggles the automatic refill feature.
[*][font=Courier New]SameTackleOnly[/font]: Replacement tackles have to be the same type as the one used up.
[*][font=Courier New]SameBaitOnly[/font]: Replacement bait have to be the same type as the one used up.
[*][font=Courier New]ConsumeChanceNormal[/font]: The probability that a fishing rod without the Preserving enchantment consumes bait/tackle. (Default: 1 = 100%)
[*][font=Courier New]ConsumeChancePreserving[/font]: The probability that a fishing rod with the Preserving enchantment consumes bait/tackle. (Default: 0.5 = 50%)
[*][font=Courier New]CrabPotTrashDoesNotEatBait[/font]: Whether crab pot trash should eat bait.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for one player only.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. (If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2360]Everlasting Bait and Unbreakable Tackles[/url], you may see the stack size of your bait increase or your tackle repair though. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7719]Unbreakable Tackles[/url] is closed source - or at least I couldn't find the source - so I don't know how this mod interacts with that one. You could alternately just set the consume chance to be zero though.)
[/list]
Technical note: this mod transpiles [font=Courier New]FishingRod.doDoneFishing[/font], so it's not likely to be compatiable with any mod that also transpiles that function.
